[[Dye Master Franjek]] is a [[collector]], a type of [[NPC]] that exchanges [[Trophy|trophies]] for items.

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Maatu Keep}}

== Dialogue ==
: ''"[[Dwayna]]'s [[blessing]]s be upon you. I am sorry to trouble you, but I am looking for samples from victim's of the plague, specifically, [[Pulsating Growth]]. Do you happen to have any you would like to be rid of? I know it sounds horrible, but I have found that when boiled, the pulsating growths make an excellent base for dyes. If you give me 5 Pulsating Growths, I will trade you this:"''
